aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:869.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. assistworld-assist-world:lever:2e718dab-.title: Executive Assistant/ Operations Administrator
assistworld-assist-world:lever:2e718dab-.description: We are recruiting on behalf of an established U.S.-based consulting and professional services firm looking for a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant / Operations Administrator to support two founders. This is a taskmaster-style role for someone who takes ownership of getting things done. The founders are highly client-facing and billable, so the goal of this position is to remove the administrative burden from their plates and ensure that important tasks, communications, invoices, documents, and follow-ups never fall through the cracks. We're looking for someone who doesn't simply wait to be told what to do. You should naturally monitor what is outstanding, identify what needs attention, chase people when necessary, and make sure tasks are completed on time. Key Responsibilities Executive & Admin support Manage and monitor administrative tasks for the founders Track outstanding actions and follow up until completion Manage calendars, meetings, appointments, and scheduling Prepare, organize, and send documents Manage digital files and documentation Draft and send routine emails and correspondence Ensure important communications are actioned promptly Keep the founders organized and aware of upcoming deadlines Invoicing & Financial Administration Prepare and send client invoices Track outstanding invoices and follow up on overdue payments Ensure invoices are issued accurately and on time Maintain organized invoice and payment records Follow up with clients regarding outstanding balances Assist with basic financial and administrative reporting Ensure recurring billing tasks are completed without reminders Task & Operations Management Maintain a clear overview of ongoing administrative tasks Chase outstanding actions with internal and external stakeholders Track deadlines, commitments, and deliverables Identify administrative bottlenecks before they become problems Create checklists and systems to prevent tasks from being missed Improve and document recurring administrative processes Take ownership of operational tasks from start to finish Microsoft 365 – Mandatory Strong Microsoft 365 proficiency is essential for this role. You should be highly comfortable working across: Microsoft Outlook Microsoft Excel Microsoft Word Microsoft PowerPoint Microsoft Teams OneDrive SharePoint Candidates should be able to work confidently within Microsoft 365 with minimal training. Strong Excel and overall Microsoft 365 knowledge will be a significant part of the role. What We're Looking For 2+ years of experience in Executive Assistance, Operations, Office Administration, or a similar position Strong experience supporting executives, founders, consultants, or professional services teams Excellent organizational and time-management skills Experience with invoicing and financial administration Strong Microsoft 365 proficiency Excellent written and spoken English Extremely detail-oriented Comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously Proactive and self-directed Confident following up and chasing outstanding tasks Comfortable handling confidential information Able to work independently in a remote environment If you're an experienced Executive Assistant who loves bringing structure, accountability, and organization to a busy business, we'd love to hear from you.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:69246aec-e0ec-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Perform API and data validation to verify application accuracy, consistency, and reliability. Support execution of automated tests within CI pipelines and recommend improvements to testing workflows and automation practices. Maintain comprehensive test cases, test procedures, documentation, and known-issue records in Qase or comparable test management systems. Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and other team discussions. Stay current with relevant testing technologies, automation techniques, and software quality practices. Hands-on experience with Playwright is strongly preferred; experience with Selenium, Cypress, or comparable automation frameworks is also valuable. Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, with JavaScript particularly beneficial given the application environment. Familiarity with C#, DHTMLX, and/or Vue.js to understand the applications being tested; deep development expertise is not required. Experience with Qase or similar test management platforms such as Xray, Zephyr, or TestRail. Experience using Jira for defect tracking and GitHub for source control and CI/pipeline integration. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, QA principles, software development life cycles, and automation best practices. Ability to create comprehensive test cases, identify edge cases, assess risks, and determine effective testing strategies. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with excellent attention to detail. Experience working within Agile or iterative development environments . jobgether-jobgether:lever:8dc799ad-90cc-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Product Data Analyst based in United States. This role offers the opportunity to make product data a central driver of strategic decision-making across a growing SaaS environment. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design teams to define meaningful metrics and improve how teams learn from data. The position combines advanced product analytics, experimentation strategy, statistical analysis, and cross-functional leadership. You will build scalable analytics and experimentation frameworks that enable teams to test assumptions and make confident decisions. Your insights will directly influence product roadmaps, business priorities, and the quality of customer experiences. You will also mentor analysts and champion stronger standards for experimentation, governance, and data storytelling. This is an ideal opportunity for an analytical leader who thrives in a high-autonomy environment and enjoys turning complex data into clear strategic action. Lead continuous discovery initiatives by helping Product Managers define success metrics, test assumptions, and incorporate iterative learning into product development. Design and improve experimentation frameworks, evaluate A/B tests and experiment outcomes, and refine hypotheses based on evidence. Develop scalable product analytics frameworks that establish consistent approaches to measurement and data-driven decision-making. Present analytical findings and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, influencing product roadmaps and business priorities. Mentor junior analysts and help strengthen their capabilities in statistical analysis, experimentation, and storytelling with data. Establish and champion best practices across Product and internal Data teams around experimentation, data governance, standardization, and data-driven decision-making. Connect product insights to broader business objectives and translate complex findings into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Foster a culture of experimentation, curiosity, continuous discovery, and evidence-based learning across Product and Engineering. Identify opportunities to improve analytics practices, experimentation velocity, and decision quality as the organization scales. Requirements 5+ years of experience in product analytics, data analytics, or a closely related role. Strong proficiency in SQL, dbt, Snowplow, Amplitude, Secoda, or comparable product analytics and data platforms. Demonstrated experience with A/B testing, hypothesis-driven research, experiment design, and evaluation. Strong expertise in statistical modeling, causal inference, data visualization, and analytical methodologies. Experience designing and implementing scalable analytics frameworks that support consistent, data-driven decision-making. Strong ability to influence Product teams and senior stakeholders through clear insights, strategic recommendations, and compelling data storytelling. jobgether-jobgether:lever:cead49cc-d570-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:6ff3f5ac-cb24-4379.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. RiseGuide – це expert-powered self-improvement застосунок для тих, хто хоче стати найкращою версією себе. Ми будуємо microlearning продукт на інсайтах і принципах видатних рольових моделей. Наші користувачі розвивають харизму на прикладі Мішель Обами та Стіва Джобса, прокачують когнітивні навички за фреймворками Джима Квіка та Барбари Оаклі, і набувають хороші звички за правилами Кобі Браянта та Мел Роббінс. Факти, а не гучні слова про RiseGuide: - Виросли в 5 разів за останній рік і продовжуємо активно масштабуватися; - 15 хвилин – середній час, який наші юзери проводять в додатку, та рейтять його на 4.6 в App Store і 4.4 на Trustpilot; - 90+ людей у команді – вихідці з провідних програм менеджменту світу та топових продуктових компаній; - Топ-2 за виручкою серед усіх бізнесів SKELAR, хоча нам всього 2 роки; - Два офіси (Варшава та Київ) + команда, що працює з усього світу. Наша ціль – переосмислити self-improvement і створити "smart scrolling" experience. Уяви, що всі найвидатніші фахівці, лідери та дослідники зібралися в одному місці, яке можна покласти в кишеню. Щоб досягти цю ціль, ми шукаємо Junior Customer Support Agent, яка/який розвиватиме зону Customer Support і допомагатиме перетворювати всі наші амбітні плани у реальні досягнення. Твої майбутні виклики: - Бути голосом і обличчям RiseGuide для користувачів: відповідати на запити через email та чати, в майбутньому — через телефонні дзвінки; працювати у змінному графіку (включно з нічними змінами) та виконувати KPI; - Покращувати процеси підтримки: від дрібних змін у макросах до тестування та запуску нових інструментів і флоу; - Занурюватися у продукт глибше, ніж будь-хто інший: швидко опановувати всі флоу підтримки, знаходити слабкі місця та допомагати робити сервіс ще зручнішим і ефективнішим. Для цього знадобляться такі навички та досвід: - 3+ місяців досвіду у Customer Support (також розглянемо кандидатів із суміжних доменів); - Вільна англійська (B2+) — комфортне письмове й усне спілкування з користувачами по всьому світу; - Увага до деталей при зборі інформації для ескалації складних запитів до відповідних команд (технічної підтримки, продуктового та лігал відділів); - Емпатія та клієнтоорієнтованість — навіть у складних ситуаціях ти залишаєш користувача з позитивним досвідом; - Швидка адаптивність — нові флоу, інструменти чи процеси ти сприймаєш як виклик, а не як перешкоду.
